svg.title: Spectrum VI
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study from the actual primary auction photograph. Approximate geometry, interpretive palette; photographic shadows, frame and texture omitted. Thirteen observed panels with visible gaps. Intervals approximate one photographed installation; installation spacing is not asserted to be fixed. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of orange, red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sothebys.com/en/auctions/ecatalogue/2007/contemporary-art-evening-n08363/lot.23.html; visually inspected2026-10-27; editable study, not a facsimile.
